Physical advantages of wheel speed sensors vs. smartphone GPS

Provides instant zero-lag speed response, exact distance progression under dense forest canopy, in tunnels, and through alpine switchbacks where satellite visibility drops, as well as sharper live slope grade (Slope %).

Enables GPS-free indirect tire pressure monitoring (iTPMS) to detect slow punctures within 150–250 m by measuring relative wheel circumference changes (identifying front vs. rear pressure loss), independent tire circumference calibration, and multi-sensor odometry fusion.
